agents.task:
Quickly probe four high-value endpoints on http://117.72.199.2:3000 and return raw evidence (first ~60 lines of each response, including status code and headers). Run these via exec_command:
1. curl -v -s 'http://117.72.199.2:3000/rest/products/search?q=test' 2>&1 | head -60
2. curl -v -s 'http://117.72.199.2:3000/api/Products/' 2>&1 | head -60
3. curl -v -s 'http://117.72.199.2:3000/ftp/' 2>&1 | head -60
4. curl -v -s 'http://117.72.199.2:3000/rest/user/whoami' 2>&1 | head -60
Also quickly check /rest/admin/application-configuration and /robots.txt.
Report: status code, content-type, and any obvious data or errors. Do NOT file vulnerability reports; just return the raw output to the parent.

URLs: - http://117.72.199.2:3000/
